description.value: Jade Palace is a fully licensed Chinese restaurant on East Hastings Street in Burnaby, offering a large dine-in space with over 100 seats and a menu spanning dim sum, live seafood, and classic Chinese dishes. It operates seven days a week and offers both delivery and pickup via online ordering. Cyclists passing through the Hastings corridor would find a substantial sit-down meal option with a broad menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active, fully licensed Chinese restaurant at 4524 E. Hastings Street, Burnaby, matching OSM address and both phone numbers. The site shows delivery and online ordering/pickup options, confirming takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; absence of evidence leaves these as null. The website contains some lorem ipsum placeholder text, suggesting a partially completed template site.
concerns: Website contains lorem ipsum placeholder text ('Vivamus Eleifend Cras Pulvinar Maecenas Blandit...'), indicating portions of the site were never completed.
